headline: Anagram Partners, River Law act on Investcorp's ₹500 crore acquisition of 20Cube
sum: Investcorp has acquired 20Cube 3PL Solutions for ~₹500 crore. Anagram Partners advised Investcorp on this acquisition.
detail: Investcorp has acquired 20Cube 3PL Solutions for ~₹500 crore. Anagram Partners advised Investcorp on this acquisition. The transaction team was led by Simone Reis (Partner) and Shwetank Chaubey (Partner) and comprised Anupam Nayak (Senior Associate), Associates Kavya Nagamangala, Rahil Arora, Kanishka Gunjiyal and Kshitij Nair. Rajesh Simhan (Partner) and Sarthak Parnami (Partner) advised on tax aspects of the transaction.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: Primary source naming the law firms, partners and teams on the matter.
